description:
Debut Album from Louis VI ' SUGAR LIKE SALT'

Executive Produced by Louis VI
All tracks produced by Louis VI except - Free Your Mind + Confidence = Jowin, WEST = Melo-Zed, False Faces = MAX BAER
Mastered by: Guy Davie @ Electric Mastering

Louis VI, "mixed-race misfit" aka "too broke to smoke" aka "the 6th man on the moon" aka "Louis Oblongata" aka 1/2 of group OthaSoul. The rapper/producer was born in London & raised by his mum after a brief interlude of living outside Paris before his parents separated (his Father being from Dominica & France). 

His first release Lonely Road of The Dreamer got praise from many giants in the hip hop world like Isaiah Rashad & his collaborators, Clear Soul Forces, Loyle Carner & Frank Ocean, which led to him working on the 'Boys Don't Cry' Magazine'
Quickly becoming known for his renowned for his intricate flows & melodies and ability to talk honestly about depression, his presence as a live performer further lifted him as an artist, 2017 saw him travel to the US to meet & record with many of the artists he was inspired by and that appear on his debut album 'Sugar Like Salt' due for release on the 15th June 2018. He also founded his apparel 'Misfit Mafia' due for first release in 2018. 

2018. Like Water. LikeWaterMusic
AWAL+/ Kobalt
